settings.heading: Terms
settings.intro: How ordering, lead time, cancellation, and the trial work.
settings.fallback_content:
These terms are the contract between you and [Legal].

Made to order

Mattresses are built after you order. The current delivery window is 8 to 10 weeks. We give a window rather than a single date because freight can move.

Cancellation

Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund, no questions asked.

30-day sleep trial

Once your mattress arrives you have 30 days. If the feel is not right, we will make you a new comfort layer to your preference, with our compliments. If that still does not settle it, we collect the mattress and refund you in full. Emperor is not covered by the 30-day return trial. Your statutory cancellation rights are unaffected.

Comfort layer

A comfort layer has its own lead time. Delivery is charged once per order.
